inputs_sent.prompt: Image 1 shows an older man at a home desk in the evening, laughing at his laptop. Make a new photo of the same man on a video call, exactly as his laptop's webcam sees him. He sits at the same desk in the same room at home in the evening, facing the camera straight on, at eye level. The framing is a typical webcam picture: his head and shoulders and the top of his chest, his face a little above the centre of the picture, with a little space above his head. He looks at his screen, just below the camera lens, with a warm, friendly and attentive face and a small smile, his lips closed. He is exactly the same man as in image 1: the same face, the same glasses, the same grey moustache and grey hair, the same skin, and the same green cardigan over a light shirt. His hands are out of the picture. Behind him, softly out of focus, the same room: the warm lamp, the plant, the shelves and the dark evening window. Warm lamp light falls on his face from one side. It looks like a real frame from a video call: natural colours, a little soft, an ordinary laptop camera, not a film still. Nothing written anywhere.
